name: Auguste Renoir
findings: Within his own canvases, copper turns up as the lightest note in 56% of the paintings that hold it, 2.7x the archive's rate (from 991 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, maroon turns up as the shadow in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 4.9x the archive's rate (from 991 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 991 paintings here).
Pairs cool grey with silver more than chance would predict (3 of 991 paintings here).
Pairs bay with nut brown more than chance would predict (3 of 991 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, white, dark jungle green) covers 58% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from smoky black, white to olive-buff, dark olive brown.
Paints most like Ker-Xavier Roussel among the painters in this archive, by palette.
